name: Klyuchyk spohadiv
source:
It has been ten years since Delilah's quiet life came to an end. Soon she goes to a mountain town to learn something there. This is one of the most important trips in her life, so she decides to prepare well for it, using the notebook of a person very dear to her...

[Translated from [url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/key-of-memories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黛利拉平静的生活结束已有十年了。不久，她去了一个山城，在那里学习一些东西。这是她一生中最重要的旅行之一，所以她决定用她最亲爱的人的笔记本为此做好充分的准备……

[译自[url=https://friend-or-foe.itch.io/key-of-memories]itch.io[/url]]
